name: Never Play
author: Vansh Bhardwaj
description: Skip songs, artists and albums you never want to hear again, plus words like sped up or karaoke. Add them from the ⋯ menu or the player. Works offline: nothing is sent anywhere.
changelog: First version: never play a song, artist or album from the ⋯ menu or the player, and skip titles with words you list.

actions.name: menu.items
actions.why: Adds Never play this song / artist / album to the ⋯ menu

actions.name: player.buttons
actions.why: Adds a Never play this song button under the player

actions.name: playback.events
actions.why: Sees each new song, to know when a blocked one comes up

actions.name: playback.control
actions.why: Skips to the next song when a blocked one starts

actions.name: storage
actions.why: Keeps your never-play list on this phone

actions.name: settings.page
actions.why: Your word list, the list's size, and clearing it

actions.name: notify
actions.why: Tells you which song was skipped and why

settings.label: Skip titles with these words
settings.description: Comma-separated, whole words, e.g. sped up, slowed, nightcore, karaoke, 8d.

settings.label: Tell me when a song is skipped
Show my list
settings.description: Says how many songs, artists and albums are on the list.

settings.label: Clear the list
settings.description: Removes every song, artist and album (not the words).

settings.label: Support Never Play
settings.description: Free and open source. A coffee keeps updates coming: ko-fi.com/vanshmusic. Also by me: Fresh Home, new releases and charts on Home.
